facts.title: Claude Code v2.1.221 发布：新增 Focus view、沙箱凭据掩码与多项修复
facts.event_hint: Claude Code v2.1.221 Focus view, sandbox credential masking, and permission/tool-chain fixes
facts.problem: Coding-agent users need clearer tool activity, safer credential handling in sandboxed commands, and reliable permission/MCP/tool-search behavior across shells, operating systems, and providers.
facts.mechanism: The release adds a VSCode Focus view that collapses tool activity into per-turn summaries with a live running-tool indicator; Linux/WSL sandbox credential masking exposes sentinel copies internally and substitutes real values only on egress (macOS falls back to deny). It also hardens shell/path permission checks, MCP startup, auto-mode parallel-call caching, Vertex tool search, and prompt-cache reuse for permission decisions.

evidence.claim: VSCode Focus view hides tool activity behind expandable per-turn summaries and shows a live running-tool indicator.
evidence.condition: Toggle via Ctrl+Alt+F or the Claude Code command

evidence.claim: Linux and WSL sandbox credential files gain a mask mode: commands read a sentinel copy while the proxy substitutes the real value on egress; macOS masking falls back to deny.
evidence.baseline: Sandbox credential access before mask mode
evidence.condition: Whole file or regex-captured spans; Linux/WSL

evidence.claim: A Bash permission-check bypass involving hidden commands in zsh [[ ]] regex conditionals was fixed, and PowerShell paths containing quote characters now prompt for approval.
evidence.condition: zsh Bash tool and Windows PowerShell paths

evidence.claim: Auto-mode permission checks for parallel tool calls are now cache-efficient, and cached conversation prefixes are reused across decisions.
evidence.condition: Auto mode with parallel tool calls

evidence.claim: Tool search on Google Vertex AI is re-enabled for Claude 4.5-generation and newer models, and MCP servers from --mcp-config connect before the first print-mode turn.

facts.evaluation_context: This is an official Claude Code release note for v2.1.221, covering VSCode, Linux/WSL, macOS, Windows PowerShell, Vertex AI, MCP, sandbox proxy, and auto-mode permission paths. The fetched GitHub page lists changes but provides no benchmark, latency, or adoption data.
facts.limitations: The release note is a qualitative change list with no measured reduction in tool calls, prompt tokens, permission latency, or failure rates. It does not establish security guarantees beyond the described masking/proxy behavior, and compatibility depends on the stated operating systems, shells, providers, and model generations. Because the candidate was discovered through AI HOT and marked discovery_only, it should be corroborated against the release or code history before becoming a core item.
facts.project_relevance: The Focus view and cache-efficient parallel permission checks are relevant to agent tool-chain observability and control, while the shell/path bypass fixes reinforce validating delegated commands at the boundary. For this project, treat the release as a B-level discovery signal and seek primary implementation or changelog confirmation before using it as evidence of measurable acceleration (inference).
